policy: Discovery identifies candidate records only. No candidate is published to Project Intelligence without human review of the primary source.

sources.name: BID Invest projects
sources.notes: Primary connector uses BID Invest's official XML project database. The public catalogue remains available as fallback. Initial review scope prioritizes Colombia and Regional records published in 2026 to control review noise.
sources.rights_note: CF Investing stores selected discovery metadata and links back to the primary source.

sources.name: CAF projects
sources.notes: Source-specific CAF connector extracts operation number, country, approval/update date, risk type, financing instrument and sector from the official project catalogue when those fields are visible. Human review remains mandatory.

sources.name: Bancóldex credit lines
sources.notes: Source-specific Bancóldex connector normalizes program date, available facility, company size, use of proceeds, sector and geographic coverage from the official credit-line catalogue. Financing facilities are not treated as investable projects.

sources.name: IFC Disclosure Portal
sources.notes: Registered for a later source-specific integration because the public portal uses dynamic search and supports its own disclosure-notification subscriptions.

sources.name: Findeter financing programs
sources.notes: Registered for later integration after defining whether the Project Explorer should ingest program-level financing records, individual financed projects, or both.
